title: Lead reply
description: One chat message from Lead; four message types of up to 60 words (design section 7).

language.description: Language of the owner's message; artifacts stay in English.

basis.description: The evidence behind the reply, one short line of at most 25 words, separate from the 60-word text (design section 7). Required with a recommendation or a spec.

checked.description: What Lead opened: file and section, PR, link, command output.

citations.description: Past decisions quoted instead of asking again.

memory.description: Durable facts for the project memory page (design section 13): at most five per reply. Each cites where it comes from: a quote of an owner message of this task, or a file of the repository. Anything else is refused.

ref.description: owner_message: a quote of at least four words from the owner's message; repo_file: the path.

duplicate_of.description: The number of an earlier task of this tenant that is the same request, from the book search in the prompt. The task then closes with a link and no spec.

spec_ready.description: true when `spec` carries the finished spec; the owner then gets it with Approve, Edit and Reject.
